रुध् (य, ङ) अनुरुध्यते 4.
d. To desire,
to love; consent to; lament.
(ध, इर, औ, ञि) रुणद्धि, रुंद्धे 7.
c. To
impede, to besiege. With अनु
to favour; with अव^1 to guard; with उप^2 to
blockade; {प्रति and वि to resist;
{सं and नि to shut in.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20200322. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/202.
[2] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20200322. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/202.

रुधिर (रं) 1.
n. Blood; saffron.
m.
The planet
Mars.
